Adversarial source checks: an app that enables snippet fetch because app assets may use CDNs cannot claim a contradictory public brief; security.md:9 expressly separates the boundaries. A conforming vanilla-browser frontend using custom labels/routes is allowed by integration.md:3 and policy.md:5, with /api/health still expressly required at integration.md:5.
